scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/frontend && npm install --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.local: npx --yes concurrently -k -n api,ui -c green,cyan "npm run backend" "npm run dev:ui"
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build:ui && npm run desktop
scripts.dev:desktop: npx --yes concurrently -k -n ui,desktop -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:ui" "cross-env FOURGIX_DEV=1 npm run desktop"
